verdict.rationale: The 01 documents general capabilities such as executing code, managing files, and controlling third-party software. None of the evidence describes a bulk or batch operation feature for acting on many items at once. General code execution is a building block a user could use to script bulk actions, not a documented bulk-operations capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
